scope: Move the project-owned Domain/OS SR10.4 assistant VM runtime into the irixium-kde-custom repository tree.
ownership: Exclusive to irixium-kde-custom; not shared with other projects or the user original.

migration.method: Same-filesystem directory move after a normal WM_DELETE shutdown; no disk copy or restore.
migration.legacy_path: The former Tempia path is now a symlink to the repository runtime.
migration.workboard_snapshots: Preserved separately at ~/tempia/ia-tema/archived/domainos-assistant-vm-workboard-20261018/; excluded from VM runtime.

shutdown.close: WM_DELETE_WINDOW sent with xdotool windowclose; process exited normally.

validation.shell_syntax: passed verify.sh and both MAME launch/network helpers
validation.verify_script: passed; three disk names resolve to the same file; no MAME process is running
validation.gitignore: runtime and private are excluded to avoid publishing mutable VM/system data
validation.launch_test: not run; no MAME restart was authorized by the move request
validation.repository_only_verifier: passed with HOME set to a fresh nonexistent subdirectory under ~/tempia, proving no required Tempia path dependency.

limits: The VM is physically inside this working tree but disk/runtime are ignored by Git. A fresh clone or remote repository will not contain them. No independent snapshot was created.

control_pointer.result: Converted to an owned regular pointer file (the prior symlink violated O_NOFOLLOW) pointing to the repository runtime control channel; compatibility file in ~/tempia/ia-tema also points to that channel.
control_pointer.readonly_status: mame_control.py status discovered the repository channel; no pending request or reply.
